papers.title: Active Learning for Community Detection in Stochastic Block Models
papers.abstract: The stochastic block model (SBM) is an important generative model for random graphs in network science and machine learning, useful for benchmarking community detection (or clustering) algorithms. The symmetric SBM generates a graph with $2n$ nodes which cluster into two equally sized communities. Nodes connect with probability $p$ within a community and $q$ across different communities. We consider the case of $p=a\ln (n)/n$ and $q=b\ln (n)/n$. In this case, it was recently shown that recovering the community membership (or label) of every node with high probability (w.h.p.) using only the graph is possible if and only if the Chernoff-Hellinger (CH) divergence $D(a,b)=(\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})^2 \geq 1$. In this work, we study if, and by how much, community detection below the clustering threshold (i.e. $D(a,b)<1$) is possible by querying the labels of a limited number of chosen nodes (i.e., active learning). Our main result is to show that, under certain conditions, sampling the labels of a vanishingly small fraction of nodes (a number sub-linear in $n$) is sufficient for exact community detection even when $D(a,b)<1$. Furthermore, we provide an efficient learning algorithm which recovers the community memberships of all nodes w.h.p. as long as the number of sampled points meets the sufficient condition. We also show that recovery is not possible if the number of observed labels is less than $n^{1-D(a,b)}$. The validity of our results is demonstrated through numerical experiments.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户的研究方向（FEA与替代建模、植入物生物力学）无关，属于图论与社区检测领域。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses community detection in stochastic block models, with no connection to finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究随机块模型中低于聚类阈值时的社区检测问题。
summary_zh.method: 通过主动学习查询少量节点标签来改进社区检测。
summary_zh.result: 在特定条件下，采样少量节点即可实现精确社区检测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证理论结果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether active learning can enable exact community detection in stochastic block models below the clustering threshold.
summary_en.method: Querying labels of a sub-linear number of nodes to recover all community memberships.
summary_en.result: Exact recovery is possible with vanishingly small labeled fractions under certain conditions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical findings.

papers.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of the near-beta titanium alloy Ti-5553 processed by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, P.O. Box 27 01 16, D-01171 Dresden, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: H. Schwab
corresponding_authors.affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, P.O. Box 27 01 16, D-01171 Dresden, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-5553钛合金的选区激光熔化工艺及力学性能，为生物医用植入体材料提供了基础数据，但未直接涉及多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure design for stress shielding mitigation, no fatigue testing, and no assessment of surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化Ti-5553钛合金的微观组织与力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备Ti-5553样品并进行微观表征和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了致密样品，微观组织为细小针状马氏体，力学性能满足要求。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜、X射线衍射和拉伸压缩试验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and mechanical properties of near-beta titanium alloy Ti-5553 fabricated by selective laser melting for potential biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: SLM was used to produce Ti-5553 samples, followed by microstructural characterization via SEM and XRD and mechanical testing including tensile and compressive tests.
summary_en.result: Fully dense samples with fine acicular martensitic microstructure were obtained, exhibiting high strength and moderate ductility suitable for load-bearing implants.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural analysis confirmed the material properties, though no fatigue or osseointegration tests were conducted.

papers.title: Surface characterization and fatigue performance of a chemical-etched Ti-6Al-4V femoral stem for cementless hip arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Federal University of São Carlos, Department of Materials Engineering, Rod. Washington Luiz km. 235, 13565-905 São Carlos, SP, Brazil

corresponding_authors.name: Leonardo Contri Campanelli
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Federal University of São Carlos, Department of Materials Engineering, Rod. Washington Luiz km. 235, 13565-905 São Carlos, SP, Brazil

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了化学蚀刻处理的Ti-6Al-4V股骨柄的疲劳性能，但未涉及股骨近端应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: No quantification of proximal femur stress/strain in Gruen zones, no micromotion with contact/friction modeling, not patient-specific, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估化学蚀刻处理对股骨柄疲劳性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 对化学蚀刻后的Ti-6Al-4V股骨柄进行表面表征和疲劳测试
summary_zh.result: 化学蚀刻改变了表面形貌，但疲劳性能有所下降
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准疲劳实验验证力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of chemical etching on the fatigue performance of a Ti-6Al-4V femoral stem for cementless hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Surface characterization and fatigue testing were conducted on chemically etched Ti-6Al-4V femoral stems.
summary_en.result: Chemical etching altered surface topography but reduced fatigue life compared to as-machined stems.
summary_en.validation: Fatigue performance was validated through cyclic loading tests according to ASTM standards.
